profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google | Graduate from The University of Texas at El Paso | Majored in Computer Science
profile.summary:
I am a recent graduate from The University of Texas at El Paso pursuing a degree in Computer Science. I am interested in new technology that benefit modern life. I am looking employment to help the growth of technology and increase the resources to reach everyone.

I am a team leader who always looks for the welfare of the team. I help other students reach their potential by providing constructional feedback in their assignments.

positions.title: Instructional Assistant
positions.description: • Lead weekly office hours to 30+ students, debugging in Java and homework assistance.

company.name: The University of Texas at El Paso

positions.title: SWE Intern
positions.description:
• Launched a Google Play Store feature to enhance the connection between Google Play Store and Android Auto Unit
• Designed a project test plan for the feature to be tested and launched
• Collaborated with a team of 8 to launch the feature

positions.title: STEP Intern
positions.description:
• Worked with Google’s infrastructures to develop Continuous Access Evaluation Protocol (CAEP) to improve Google Workspace security by enabling third parties to dynamically alter access to their services based on signals provided by Google.
• Designed a project document for Google’s CAEP security service objectives and functionalities.
• Collaborated with a team of 4 to design and implement CAEP from scratch, oversaw the transmitter that received and sent security signals.
